name: Native Spirituality
overview: Scripture clearly commands exclusive worship of the one true God, forbidding the worship of other gods or idols as stated in Exodus 20:3 and Psalms 96:5. God warns His people not to adopt the abominable practices of the nations they encounter, including their spiritual customs, as emphasized in Deuteronomy 18:9 and Deuteronomy 12:29. While the heavens and creation reflect God's glory and handiwork (Psalms 19:1), the worship of created things such as the sun, moon, and stars is expressly prohibited (Deuteronomy 4:19), underscoring the biblical call to reject native spiritual practices that elevate created objects or beings to divine status.
